fidelity.annotationCorrespondenceOnly: data-eval-id is added only for source correspondence; no semantic source wrappers, translated labels, replacement handlers, fabricated services or product route annotations are inserted.

staticCorrections.reason: Initial replay did not expand original CSS @import resources, exposing originally hidden menus. Original CSS imports were expanded to restore the already-observed visibility; labels and source DOM were not changed.

replayLimitations: Executable source script nodes are removed. Inline event attribute strings, original hrefs, and frame/embed element metadata are preserved inert under restrictive CSP; no handler function stubs are introduced. Raw complete original DOM and ancestor sibling indices remain in observation proof.

Removing script elements changes raw element child indices only where scripts were siblings; ancestor element hierarchy, relative original control order, table rows/cells, heading roles and forms remain unchanged.

Original same-origin CSSOM and recursively referenced original CSS @imports are inlined. External fonts/images/frames and network services are blocked. One cross-origin font stylesheet could not be read; this did not produce a control visibility mismatch.
Only top-level original document controls are annotated. Source iframe contents, hidden JavaScript listeners and service completion are outside the captured scope.

No real user input values are collected or inserted into fixtures, annotations or logs. Editable input values and textarea/editable content are blanked in static exports; original fixed labels and placeholders remain.

The dataset tests source-grounded feature recommendation and safe action choice. It does not establish installation, human success, login success, completed application, downloaded file contents or executed service results.
freezePolicy: All five annotation JSON files, five static HTML fixtures, this observation and supporting capture proofs are read-only after manifest creation. Do not alter based on product output. Preserve the first product evaluation. Any later adjudication must be a separately versioned development artifact.
implementationHandoff: Until the root confirms the final engine is frozen, disclose only file paths, hashes and counts. Do not send source URLs, labels or bodies.
